content.text:
Improvements made to `0.html`:

- Gave it a readable `<title>` instead of the hash string.
- Added `box-sizing: border-box` and a light page background for visual polish.
- Made the SVG responsively sized (`min(400px, 90vw)`) so it scales on small screens instead of overflowing.
- Added a visible fill color (`#2563eb`) since the circle previously had no fill styling.
- Slightly reduced the circle radius (195 vs 200) so the stroke/edge isn't clipped at the viewBox boundary.
- Added `role="img"` and `aria-label` for accessibility, since an unlabeled decorative SVG isn't accessible to screen readers.
